questions.q: What is the central question the passage explores?
options: Whether Kennedy will run for president in 2028 after the blue wave
Whether MAHA-backed candidates will fare better in the coming primaries
Whether Trump will fire Kennedy after the disappointing election results
Whether Democrats will try to remove Kennedy or work with him
questions.explain: The passage asks whether Democrats will push Kennedy out or collaborate on shared health priorities.

questions.q: What phrase did Kennedy use in his post three days after the election?
options: Make America Healthy Again forever
It is time to unleash the Kraken
The Senate has no leverage left
Build a Healthier America
questions.explain: Kennedy wrote 'It's time to unleash the Kraken' on X.

questions.q: Why did many MAHA Moms feel betrayed by President Trump?
options: He signed an order cutting federal funding for organic farmers
He publicly mocked the MAHA Moms movement on social media
He issued an order ramping up glyphosate production
He dropped his pledge to let Kennedy go wild on health
questions.explain: They felt betrayed when he issued an executive order ramping up production of the weedkiller glyphosate.

questions.q: What did Kennedy say about the Senate at the MAHA Action party?
options: It would soon confirm his appointees
It no longer has any leverage over him
It had voted to impeach him
It would create a new MAHA committee
questions.explain: Kennedy said the Senate no longer has any leverage over him, which he called a big deal.

questions.q: Why might Kennedy's position inside the White House be stronger despite the election?
options: Stephen Miller, an ally, is replacing chief of staff Susie Wiles
Susie Wiles has agreed to back the MAHA agenda in full
Democrats have pledged to confirm his future appointees
Trump promised to rescind the glyphosate order next month
questions.explain: Trump replaced Wiles, accused of blocking MAHA policies, with Miller, whom Kennedy calls the strongest MAHA supporter after himself.
